# Md. Ashfaq Sadat

> Doctoral researcher in the Department of Fisheries Management, Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU), Mymensingh, Bangladesh. He studies microplastics and chemical contaminants such as triclosan and ivermectin in fish and rivers, and what they mean for ecosystems and for people who eat the fish.

This file is a plain-text summary of https://ashfaq-sadat.github.io/ for AI assistants and search tools.

## Key facts

- Name: Md. Ashfaq Sadat (cited as Sadat MA or M. A. Sadat)
- Role: PhD researcher, Department of Fisheries Management, Bangladesh Agricultural University
- Supervisor: Professor Kizar Ahmed Sumon
- Co-supervisor: Professor Harunur Rashid
- Fellowships: BIMReN Split-Site PhD Fellowship (BIMSTEC-India Marine Research Network, 2024); UGC PhD Fellowship (University Grants Commission of Bangladesh, 2024); BAURES MS Research Fellowship (Bangladesh Agricultural University Research System, July 2020 to June 2021); HSC Board Scholarship, General Grade (Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education, Dinajpur, 2013)
- PhD topic: microplastics in the Old Brahmaputra River and their role as carriers of pharmaceuticals and personal care products to Nile tilapia (started October 2024)
- Research interests: microplastics, ecotoxicology, triclosan, environmental risk assessment, One Health
- Main study organism: Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus), larvae to adults
- Skills: R, SPSS, SQL and Power BI; KoboToolbox and SurveyCTO field surveys; ArcGIS, QGIS and Google Earth Engine; FTIR polymer identification, haematology and histology, qPCR
- Founder of Nexalyze Lab (https://www.nexalyzelab.com, since 2022), which teaches data analysis, GIS and research tools and has supported data analysis for more than fifty MS and two PhD projects
- Previous roles: Lead Enumerator and Enumerator, WorldFish Bangladesh One Health programme (2022-2023); Research Fellow, post-harvest fish loss project, BAU (2021-2022); GIS Survey Lead, JICA marine fish landing centre survey, Cox's Bazar (2021)
- Education: MS in Fisheries Management (2019-2021) and BSc in Fisheries (Hons., 2015-2018), both at Bangladesh Agricultural University

## Publications

- [Combined toxicity of polyethylene microplastics and chromium on the developmental stage of Nile tilapia](https://doi.org/10.1007/s13530-026-00341-8): Toxicology and Environmental Health Sciences, 2026
- [Microplastics pollution in aquatic ecosystems of Bangladesh: a critical review on research trends and future perspectives](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.scitotenv.2025.180620): Science of the Total Environment 1002, 180620, 2025
- [A comprehensive review on the negative impacts on Sundarbans fisheries](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.marpolbul.2025.118409): Marine Pollution Bulletin 220, 118409, 2025
- [Increase in temperature increases ingestion and toxicity of polyamide microplastics in Nile tilapia](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chemosphere.2023.138502): Chemosphere 327, 138502, 2023
- [Winter bloom of marine cyanobacterium, Trichodesmium erythraeum and its relation to environmental factors](https://doi.org/10.3390/su15021311): Sustainability 15(2), 1311, 2023
- [Haor-based floodplain-rich freshwater ichthyofauna in Sylhet Division, Bangladesh](https://doi.org/10.3390/conservation2040042): Conservation 2(4), 639-661, 2022

## Presentations

- Combined effects of polyethylene microplastics and chromium on growth, haemato-biochemistry and erythrocyte morphology of Nile tilapia. 1st International Scientific Conference on Sustainable Aquaculture and Fisheries, Chattogram, April 2025
